# PLASMA Fixed Image ABI v1 — SWD Site 1 Vertical Slice / RTL Feasibility Review

**Gate 1 result classification: simulation-only RTL and Driver proof candidate.**
**M1 Architecture Freeze: NO-GO.** No valid fixed-image bitstream or PYNQ-Z2 deployment is generated by this PR. No actual Kernel/UIO/MMIO/FPGA Manager access, external SWD pin activity, DUT programming or electrical claim.

## Why this test

A fixed Universal Image must satisfy **the same register, transaction, status and response semantics** through the PS/Driver and RTL layers. Existing SWD-03 uses a different register map and already demonstrates the SWD waveform; blindly declaring it ABI v1 would be incorrect. This isolated Site-1 RTL slice uses the **new candidate Site offset** and **reuses the existing verified SWD master** without changing its physical runtime or old HIL behavior.

## Simulation-only implementation

- `pl/rtl/bus/fixed_fpga_swd_site_axi_lite.sv`: standalone AXI4-Lite **Site 1** window `0x40004000` (simulation address, not a new physically provisioned block). Read-only Site 1 ID, `0x00010000` ABI, SWD bit0 capability; 32-bit strict aligned native writes and exact RO/WO offset decoding. AW/W independent capture, bounded single outstanding AXI B and R responses, no read/write alias and no partial WSTRB.
- `swd_transaction_master` and `swd_waveform_engine` remain **unchanged**. `SWD_XFER=1` and `SWD_LINE_RESET=2` map to its existing command ports; SWD PHY loopback/virtual-target code reused. It does **not** implement PPU-wide Identity/global control, SPI, multi-Site, per-Site Power/OE/NRST or image loader.
- `pl/verification/models/fixed_swd_site_driver.py` is a **simulation port only**; it exercises a *bounded* command setup, COMMIT-last sequence, polling, `DONE_SEQ` match, `DONE_STATUS`, `DONE_DATA`, and ACK. It does not open `/dev/uio*`, `/dev/mem` or control hardware.
- `pl/verification/cocotb/test_fixed_fpga_swd_site_axi.py` checks aligned writes, simulated invalid AXI requests (which must **never** be sent to real Z2), unsupported SPI, read-only protection, independent AW/W timing, duplicate command denial, stale ACK rejection, reset and SWD DPIDR `0x2BA01477`. The injected driver must work end-to-end with RTL and a **virtual** SWD target. Separate Host negative tests check sequence poisoning and unexpected AXI response.
- A dedicated GitHub-hosted Icarus/Cocotb workflow runs in an isolated software CI job; it contains no self-hosted hardware actor and no bitstream build.

## Contract overlap and deliberate first-slice limitations

| Dimension | ABI v1 candidate | This Site-1 slice | Gap before M1 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Zynq-7020 / fixed image | One 64-KiB PPU window | Standalone *Site-only* 4-KiB RTL slave; `0x40004000` default | PPU identity/global control, AXI interconnect, memory map source proof |
| Site count | 8 possible, present bitmap factual | One only; no fabricated other Sites | 2-Site then eight-Site actual RTL and capacity |
| SWD command | `SWD_XFER`, `SWD_LINE_RESET` | Single Site transfer + existing waveform master | Formal timeout/fault mapping, clock semantics, low-level ACK detail |
| SWD_LINE_RESET count | 50–128 logical-high clocks | **Only 64** accepted, existing master uses its fixed recovery waveform | **Decide RTL change or narrow v1 normative ABI** before freeze |
| CLOCK_DIV | 1–65535 candidate | **2–65535** maps existing SWD half-period counter | Normalize minimum and timing unit |
| Sequence/ACK | Explicit ID per Site + abort policy | One outstanding, DONE_SEQ, ACK_SEQ, no blind replay | Power-loss/owner-epoch provenance, persistent fault recovery |
| FIFO/SPI | Bounded PIO FIFO, SPI full-duplex | **Not implemented**; FIFO registers return zero, SPI rejects | RTL FIFO, Clock/CS, engine sharing arbitration, performance |
| Host bus ordering | Native aligned Device MMIO | Cocotb AXI handshake only | Actual ARM barrier/device-map qualification |
| Isolation/fault | Per-Site electrical safety plus Kernel resource ownership | No GPIO power/NRST/OE, no physical ownership | Board/safety design, UIO Kernel evidence, external recovery |
| RTL resources | Prove Zynq-7020 LUT/FF/BRAM/timing budget | **Not synthesized**; Icarus simulation only | Vivado out-of-context timing and later 2→8 Site projections |

**Important ABIv1 mismatch identified:** The fixed v1 document currently states SWD line reset 50–128 cycles and CLOCK_DIV 1–65535. The reused SWD master only implements a qualified 64-cycle high reset segment after preamble, and half-period 2 or greater. The RTL slice **rejects unsupported values instead of pretending to implement them**. Before declaring M1 GO, decide whether to revise ABI v1 requirements, or extend and requalify the waveform master. This work does NOT amend the currently merged ABI without further design review.

**Incomplete command/error semantics:** Legacy master has `NEED_RESET` distinct from v1 `BAD_ARGUMENT`; this slice maps it to v1 status 7. It also exposes SWD ACK metadata internally but v1 data plane has no named ACK register. Mapping to `SWD_NO_ACK` cannot recover precise wire ACK bits. These choices need an ABI/RTL signoff. Current timeout path can leave an uncertain target state and the slice latches FAULT; no unattended re-admission after a fatal state.

## Acceptance and evidence ladder

1. **Host-only compile + Cocotb**: Icarus successfully compiles the new Site slave with the reused SWD engine; simulated AXI, SWD line reset and virtual DPIDR pass. All invalid address/WSTRB injection remains strictly simulation-only.
2. **M1 design review**: decide exact normative line-reset/clock fields, distinguish SWD ACK vs result codes, refine FAULT/ACK/recovery, sequence ordering and a hardware-qualified memory barrier, decide minimal SPI requirement and shared engine ownership; make one Board Descriptor/layout source authoritative.
3. **Separate later Gate 1**: real RTL Identity, at least one real SWD Site, cocotb coverage and Zynq-7020 build/timing report; then separately approved real Z2 HIL with power/pin and Kernel/AXI safety evidence. Neither hardware code nor board operations are authorized by this PR.

### No claims made

- The existing `base.bin`, LT02, MS01, or installed PYNQ-Z2 image do **not** implement this ABI v1 slice.
- A simulation-only DPIDR proves the **test fixture and interface behavior**, not SWD physical timings or an actual IC.
- Success is **not** hardware M1 GO, eight-Site implementation, real UIO Driver availability, SPI readiness, or production deployment approval.

Test commands (on an independent Host with `iverilog`, `pytest`, `cocotb` and `cocotb-test` installed):

```bash
python -m pytest -q pl/tests/test_fixed_swd_site_slice_source.py
python -m pytest -q pl/verification/test_fixed_fpga_swd_site_rtl.py
```
